title: ADscan group membership snapshot v1
description: domains/<domain>/memberships.json: the MemberOf graph of one domain as collected (nodes and edges), plus the memberships an attack step created or proved at run time (runtime_memberships) and the derived lookup maps the attack-path engine reads (user_to_groups, group_to_parents, ...). Written by the collector and updated through one writer when a run proves a membership (adscan_internal/services/membership_snapshot.py). Version marker: schema_version, 'membership-1.<minor>'; version is the engine's internal layout counter. nodes, edges and generated_at are present once the domain was collected; a file a run created before any collection carries only the runtime memberships and the lookup maps. The implicit primary-group membership (Domain Users) is not always an edge: read user_to_groups when present. Declared objects may gain fields within a major; do not reject unknown keys. Node properties and edge notes are opaque.

node.$comment: The collector's graph payload of a directory object. A light endpoint node for a group of another collected domain carries only its identity.

runtime_membership.$comment: A membership an attack step created (and ADscan will revert) or proved effective. user or computer names the member.
